EXPLANATORY NOTE .

IS : 3455-l 971 `Gauging practice for plain workpieces (first revision)' specifies the dimensions for different types of plug, ring and gap gauges. This standard gives in a tabulated form, the calculated values of the gauging allowances and manufacturing tolerances for cylindrical and flat plug gauges and spherical ended plug gauges of nominal sizes up to 500 mm for selected IS0 tolerance zones as recommended in ISO/R 1829-1970 `Selection of tolerance zones for general purposes'. This standard supplements the details given in IS : 3455-l 971. For individual gauges reference should be made to the foilowing standards : a) IS : 6137-1971 b) IS : 6138-1971 30 mm) c) IS : 6244-1971 d) IS : 62451971 100 mm) e) IS : 6246-1971 250 mm) f) IS : 6247-1971 250 mm) Gauging members for plain plug gauges `GO member' (size range 1 to 30 mm) Gauging members for plain plug gauges `NO GO member' (size range 1 to Gauging members for plain plug gauges `GO' member (size range 30 to 100 mm) Gauging members for plain plug gauges `NO GO' member (size range 30 to Gauging members for plain plug gauges `GO' member (size range 100 to

Gauging members for plain plug gauges `NO GO' member (size range 100 to Technical supply conditions for gauges

g) IS : 7018-1973

In the preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from DIN 7164-1966 `Arbeitslehrdorne und Kugelendmasse fur IS0 Passmasse von 1 bis 500 mm Nennmass Lehrenmasse und Herstelltoleranzen (Workshop plug gauges and spherical plug gauges for ISO-fit sizes from 1 up to 500 mm nominal size; deviations and tolerances for gauges)' issued by DIN Deutsches lnstitut fur Normung.
